headline: US Justice Department Targets Student Aid Fraud Ring Tied to Kenya
summary: The US Justice Department charged five individuals and seized US$750,000 in cryptocurrency in connection with a student aid fraud scheme linked to Kenya.
why: Cross-border financial crimes and cryptocurrency seizures highlight regulatory enforcement risks and anti-money laundering compliance issues in digital asset transfers.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency
impacts.why: Law enforcement seizures underscore regulatory tracking of illicit crypto transactions.
